method.distance: equal-weight missing-aware Gower on two ordinal, one nominal, and one binary original survey response
method.pac_policy: comparative only; no universal absolute cutoff

names.1: Diagnostic: did not work while studying

decision.status: No sufficiently robust Branch G educational/cultural-capital segmentation found

limitations: These are exploratory educational/cultural-capital response profiles, not measures of intelligence, merit, or respondent worth.
Parental education is a proxy for inherited cultural capital and unknown/refusal is pairwise unavailable rather than ranked.
Current education status is nominal, and working while studying is a work-exposure indicator rather than inherited cultural capital itself.
No cultural-capital scale is constructed; all four original indicators receive equal maximum Gower weight.
Leave-one-feature-out and single-feature checks are essential because prior branches produced work-exposure-led solutions.
If no candidate satisfies the cross-algorithm minimum-size rule, the selected solution is retained only to diagnose the rejection and must not be used as a profile classification.
Permutation calibration tests whether the selected structure exceeds independently shuffled variables, but it does not establish theoretical construct validity.
The Branch G sample contains only 56 valid respondents; confirmation in additional data is required.
